Upstream license declaration record

Source repository: https://github.com/BarisSozen/claude
Audit date: 2026-07-26

The upstream README contains a "License: MIT" section and package.json declares
"license": "MIT". No standalone LICENSE file or separate copyright notice was
present when audited. Redistribution is therefore based on the explicit MIT
identifier supplied by the upstream project. This evidence is weaker than a
bundled full license file and is classified as medium confidence in
OPEN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.
